verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a first-party Source Map Upload API and says it automatically un-minifies JavaScript when source maps are provided, so the core outcome is delivered. The story's specific upload paths, a CLI command or bundler plugin, are not evidenced: the documented Ruby CLI only shows commands like `honeybadger deploy`, not source map upload. Missing for 10: documented CLI source-map upload command, bundler plugin (webpack/Vite/etc.), CI workflow guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of symbolicated stack traces.
